added.description:
Job Description

Ensure compliance with TRI Standard Operating Procedures, Food and Drug Administration regulations, World Health Organization (WHO) guidance, and applicable global requirements for reporting adverse events to regulatory agencies.
Support clinical research by collecting, reporting, and sharing adverse event information and related findings for marketed drugs and investigational agents.
Maintain and update agent-specific summary tables of clinical and preclinical toxicity studies for investigational agents.
Perform literature searches.
Support clinical research through adverse event analysis and processing, and serious adverse event reconciliation.
Review experimental protocols and informed consent documents, as needed, and prepare, review, and edit presentations on safety issues.
Develop and maintain specifications, mappings, validation rules, and reconciliation controls for E2B Individual Case Safety Report (ICSR) transfers and safety-system interfaces.
Develop line listing comparisons, safety listings, summaries, reconciliations, dashboards, and periodic reports, including outputs supporting the Development Safety Update Report (DSUR).
Develop metrics to monitor ICSR processing and regulatory submission timelines and due dates.
Configure Oracle Argus studies, develop automated ICSR quality control (QC) tools, and review case reporting rules, code lists, and auto-narrative templates in Argus after completing required training and obtaining authorization.
Translate Safety Management Plan and Statement of Work requirements into database mappings, workflow controls, QC checklists, escalation trackers, and traceable test evidence.
Develop automated checks for case completeness, narrative consistency, chronology, reportability workflows, and submission readiness, including query generation for discrepancies or incorrect clinical information, while preserving required human review.
Develop and automate reports summarizing Excel comparison results and study information.
Collaborate with PVG, medical reviewers, IT, Quality Assurance, Regulatory Operations and clients, and escalate risks that could affect quality or reporting timelines.
Provide technical support for systems that facilitate the exchange of safety-related data between clinical and safety databases.
Support the data integration aspects of MedDRA and WHO Drug Dictionary coding tasks.

Job Requirements

Demonstrated proficiency in data transformation, reconciliation, and programming QC checklists, along with a working knowledge of relational data, SQL, and SAS.
Experience translating clinical research requirements into traceable specifications, validated checks, and reproducible reporting workflows in a regulated environment.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to prepare documentation, deliver client-facing presentations, facilitate productive meetings, and explain complex information to technical and nontechnical audiences. Ability to collaborate across functions, manage multiple priorities, and escalate risks promptly.
Ability to complete required training and demonstrate competency before independently implementing safety-system configurations, mappings, interfaces, or submission changes.
Experience with Oracle Argus Safety Console, configuration of studies and expedited workflow, XML, E2B(R2/R3), ICSR data exchange through gateway or web service integrations, comparable data intake systems, and FAERS or other electronic submission systems preferred.
Experience with safety and clinical datasets, regulatory submissions, DSUR outputs, and dashboards.
Experience developing automated QC checklists, reconciliation tools, reports, auto-narratives, and reusable validated automation.
This is a hybrid position with 2 days in TRI's Bethesda, Maryland office, and 3 days working remotely.

The AI and Automation Engineer designs, prototypes, builds, integrates, evaluates, and helps productionize AI-enabled and automation solutions that address defined business and project needs. Working within TRI’s AI and Digital Enablement capability, the AI and Automation Engineer translates qualified opportunities into working solutions using established AI models and services (focused on Azure/Foundry), agents, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), workflow automation, data integration, and other appropriate technologies. The role emphasizes rapid experimentation, integration, and measurable evaluation, including recognizing when conventional automation or existing technology provides a better solution than AI. 
This is an applied AI engineering role, not an AI research or model-development position. The AI and Automation Engineer is not expected to develop, train, or research new foundation models. Inste.ad, the engineer selects, configures, integrates, grounds, evaluates, and applies existing models and AI services within secure enterprise solutions. The engineer works closely with Business Liaisons, business SMEs, application developers, infrastructure, and security teams to move promising concepts from prototype through evaluation, pilot, and production. Current areas of emphasis include Microsoft Foundry and Azure AI services, RAG and enterprise knowledge solutions, AI agents, Power Platform automation, enterprise integration, and evaluation of solution quality, security, performance, cost, and business value. This aligns with TRI’s planned model in which AI Engineers build and evaluate solutions while leveraging reusable platform and architecture patterns rather than developing underlying AI models

Job Requirements

Software/application development experience, preferably Python plus API/integration development in C#. 
Demonstrated experience building AI-enabled or automation solutions. 
Understanding of generative AI, LLMs, prompt/context engineering, RAG and AI agents. 
Experience integrating applications, APIs, data sources and enterprise systems. 
Experience evaluating, troubleshooting and improving AI or automation solutions. 
Understanding of cloud security, authentication, access control and secure data handling. 
Strong problem-solving, prototyping and iterative-development skills. 
Hands-on experience designing, developing, and implementing Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) solutions, including document ingestion, data chunking, embedding generation, retrieval optimization, and integration with Large Language Models (LLMs) to deliver accurate, context-aware AI applications. 
Working knowledge of vector databases, vector search, and semantic search technologies, including embedding models, similarity search, hybrid search, and retrieval techniques to efficiently index, retrieve, and process structured and unstructured enterprise data. 
Experience with LLM fine-tuning and model customization techniques, including dataset preparation, supervised fine-tuning, parameter-efficient fine-tuning (e.g., LoRA/QLoRA), and model evaluation to optimize performance, accuracy, and domain-specific capabilities. 

Strongly Preferred 

Microsoft Foundry / Azure AI services. 
Azure AI Search / Foundry IQ and RAG architectures. 
Power Automate / Power Platform. 
Azure OpenAI or other model APIs. 
Azure application services and identity. 
Microsoft Graph and Microsoft 365 integration. 
Agentic solution development. 
AI evaluation and observability. 
Clinical research, life sciences, regulatory or federal contracting experience. 
Experience with enterprise document/knowledge systems. 
Experience productionizing prototypes. 
Familiarity with regulated or validated environments. 
Experience applying AI to document intelligence, workflow automation, knowledge retrieval, QC or decision-support use cases. 
This role is fully remote for those living in the DMV area. (Maryland, Virginia, Washington D.C.)

At KBR, we deliver science, technology and engineering solutions to governments and companies around the world. KBR employs approximately 37,000 people worldwide with customers in more than 85 countries and operations in over 28 countries. KBR is proud to work with its customers across the globe to provide technology, value-added services, and long-term operations and maintenance services to ensure consistent delivery with predictable results.

Trinzic is the future independent company to be created through the planned spin-off of KBR's Mission Technology Solutions business, expected in January 2027. Our people work at the frontier of what is possible, delivering solutions in challenging environments and advancing some of the world's highest-priority national security and space missions. 

Backed by decades of mission success, deep expertise, and trusted partnerships, Trinzic will launch as a global organization with more than 18,000 employees supporting customers around the world. Join us at a defining moment and help shape the future of a company built to tackle complex challenges and make a meaningful impact. 

Candidates who join KBR's Mission Technology Solutions business before the spin-off will transition to Trinzic when the separation is complete and will not need to reapply for employment.

KBR is seeking a Senior Data Engineer (Lakehouse & Application Development) to design, develop, and optimize modern data platforms and web-based applications supporting Department of Defense Science & Engineering (S&E) initiatives.

This role combines backend web development and data engineering to design, build, and sustain an on-premises data platform supporting Science & Engineering (S&E) data integration, management, and analysis.

Evaluate technical alternatives and recommend architectures, technologies, and implementation approaches.

Experience designing and implementing robust ETL pipelines, including distributed and parallel processing, workflow orchestration, fault tolerance, error handling, and idempotent processing.

Experience with Power BI or Tableau
Demonstrated ability to work independently and provide sound technical recommendations.

The Software Integration Engineer serves as the Engineering Project Manager for EUV Source software releases, with end-to-end responsibility for coordinating successful software delivery from content definition through qualification and release.

Define and maintain release content and timing, by aligning with System Integration, EUV Factory, Customer Support, Software Development, and other key stakeholders on critical progression and fix content, priorities, dependencies, and delivery timing.
